QuestInfo.name: The Name of the Healer
QuestInfo.0: Paeon is acting strange. You need to stop him.
QuestInfo.1:
Paeon acknowledged how he judged you over your past life when he should have accepted your present one. 
...He then says he'll return his power to Gaia. His body starts to vanish.

Wait, no! Stop, Paeon!
QuestInfo.2:
Paeon said his '#rsacrifice#k' was his way of healing and protecting the forest. He will return his power to Gaia, even if his body has to vanish.

You felt your will and desire to protect everyone, on a much deeper level than before.
You've gained a new understanding of your power.
